notes: Cishan culture of southern Hebei and northern Henan; the page and infobox give 6500-5000 BC, so it began before the project's first year and the dossier starts at -6000. Extent: the page gives 'Hebei, Henan', the type site at Wu'an 'on the eastern foothills of the Taihang Mountains' and nothing else (no site count, no area), so one 90 km disc around Handan is drawn (Wu'an is not in the gazetteer; Handan is the nearest listed city); confidence 2 for the year, the disc is a placement. Relations: the page calls the Peiligang 'its southern neighbor' and the Beixin 'its eastern neighbor' (no dates on the page); infobox 'Preceded by: Nanzhuangtou', 'Followed by: Yangshao culture'. The Yangshao page lists Cishan among its predecessors without a date, so 5000 is the Yangshao start. The early millet dates 'have been questioned by some archaeologists'. Sino-Tibetan origin is the page's remark, not drawn. No Cliopatria shape, no area figure.
